home.title: Give a connection the time to exist.
home.intro: Histae is for people who prefer attention over reflexes, curiosity over endless scrolling, and consent at every step.

time.title: Time
time.text: No swiping race. Every conversation is given room to breathe.

reciprocity.title: Reciprocity
reciprocity.text: A match never moves forward alone: both people choose what comes next.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: Reporting tools and moderation are part of the product, not a footnote.

home.rhythmTitle: From discovery onward, every step is chosen.
home.rhythmIntro: Histae brings compatible profiles together, then lets reciprocity and consent decide what happens next.

preferences.title: 01 · Define what matters
preferences.text: Age ranges, distance, who you are looking for and personality traits give discovery a clear framework.

mutualChoice.title: 02 · Choose each other
mutualChoice.text: The feed applies both people’s preferences. Only two reciprocal likes create a match.

conversation.title: 03 · Talk for 24 hours
conversation.text: Conversation begins without immediately exposing photos, leaving room to discover the person first.

continuation.title: 04 · Continue and reveal together
continuation.text: Continuing and revealing photos are separate shared choices, so both people keep their own pace.

home.featuresTitle: A complete experience designed as one system.
home.featuresIntro: Profiles, discovery, conversation and data control work together to create a clearer framework.

profiles.title: Profiles and traits
profiles.text: First name, age, bio and personality traits help people understand someone before their photo is revealed.

preferences.title: Mutual preferences
preferences.text: Age ranges, who each person is looking for and maximum distance are checked in both directions.

location.title: Location-based discovery
location.text: The feed uses a recent location, shows rounded distance and relies on separate location consent.

likes.title: Reciprocal likes
likes.text: Only two likes create a match. Assessed, blocked and already matched profiles leave the feed.

matches.title: Two-stage matches
matches.text: A first 24-hour window opens conversation, then a second lets both people choose whether to continue.

photoReveal.title: Mutual reveal
photoReveal.text: Photos appear only after both people agree, independently from the decision to continue.

messaging.title: Messaging and read status
messaging.text: Messages belong to the match, are timestamped and can only be marked read by their recipient.

privacy.title: Safety and privacy
privacy.text: Consent, blocks, reports, data export, rights requests and complete deletion are built into the account.

home.safetyText: Histae includes blocking, reporting, moderation and directly accessible data rights. Sensitive choices, such as location and preferences, rely on explicit consent that can be withdrawn.
home.closingText: The app is being prepared. Follow the launch to discover Histae when it arrives.
